BiblicalUsage: Jokim is named once, in 1 Chronicles 4:22. In 1 Chronicles 4:22 we read, "And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem."
TheologicalSignificance: Jokim is never just a name, and I believe a real life stands behind it.
